body:
All [intruder] in each [corridorNWSE] move.
Then, all [intruder] in every Room move.

In Sections with an [lifeSupportActive]:
Place a [fire] in each
Life Support Control Room.

In Sections with an [lifeSupportInactive]:
Place a [malfunction] in each
Life Support Control Room.

Each [character] makes a Noise roll.
